czech: Už jsem odešel, když jsi zavolal.
english: I'd already left when you called.
You'd finished the work before lunch.

czech: On už jedl, takže neměl hlad.
english: He'd already eaten, so he wasn't hungry.
She'd arrived before the meeting started.

czech: Rozbilo se to před koncem záruky.
english: It had broken before the warranty ended.
